name: Dragon CRS-12
about: Dragon CRS-12 (2017-045A), a crewed vehicle (Dragon), launched 2017 Aug 14. One orbit from GCAT's satcat (shape and inclination; orientation estimated), then how that phase ended (GRP).

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was; the orbit is GCAT's at its epoch (2017 Aug 16), held fixed
docked to A06499; it stays docked here until it lands; the undocking is folded into the landing (a fudge of hours)
the landing time is GCAT's end of mission (psatcat TDate); the point stands in for the programme's usual recovery area, from memory

events.why: the landing time is GCAT's end of mission (psatcat TDate)
